Sunny-Side Up Eggs

Ingredients:
2 eggs
1 tsp olive oil (or cooking spray)
Pinch of salt
Pinch of black pepper

Instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
2. Crack the eggs into the pan, keeping the yolks whole.
3. Cover the pan and cook 2-3 minutes, until the whites are fully set but the yolks are still runny.
4. Season with salt and pepper and slide onto a plate.
note: Everyday staple, 1 serving. Kosher: pareve. Category: Main. Tags: eggs, breakfast, lunch, quick, staple.
